create_subclass_Module: create a subclass of Module that implements training_step, validation_step, and configure_optimizers
implement_training_step: implement the training_step method in a Module subclass to process a batch and return loss
implement_validation_step: implement the validation_step method in a Module subclass to evaluate a batch and return metrics
implement_configure_optimizers: implement configure_optimizers in a Module subclass to return an optimizer with optional lr scheduler
override_on_train_epoch_end: override on_train_epoch_end in a Module subclass to run custom logic at the end of each training epoch
